parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It is a long, narrow component attached to the frame to rest over the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability, holding the eyeglasses in place on the wearer’s head.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of plastic. It mirrors the left leg and provides balance and support.
parts.Functional_description: It helps secure the eyeglasses on the wearer’s head, ensuring comfort and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint for folding and unfolding, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The frame holds the lenses in place and connects to the legs.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the optical function of vision correction or protection and serves as the structural core of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the legs rotate around its hinges.
